description: Pattern-based prevention rules for Sword of Hope — Godot 4 GDScript regression detection (273 files, ~52K LOC)

rules.name: Duplicated system directories (parallel implementations)
rules.message: Parallel system directory detected — duplicated logic causes confusion about which system is active
rules.suggestion: Consolidate to a single system; remove the old directory or refactor shared logic into a common module

rules.name: AudioStreamPlayer without stream resource
rules.message: AudioStreamPlayer node may have null stream — verify audio file exists and is assigned
rules.suggestion: Assign stream property in scene or _ready(): $AudioStreamPlayer.stream = preload('res://assets/audio/sfx.ogg')

rules.name: Texture/sprite resource path without existence verification
rules.message: Texture resource path referenced — CI must verify file exists at this path
rules.suggestion: Run asset integrity check in CI: grep all res:// paths and verify with file existence test

rules.name: Large file without type hints (52K LOC risk)
rules.message: Untyped variable in large codebase — type hints are critical for maintainability at 52K LOC
rules.suggestion: Add explicit type: var speed: float = 200.0

rules.name: Duplicate function names across directories
rules.message: Function name appears in multiple directories — possible duplicated logic across parallel systems
rules.suggestion: Consolidate to a single implementation or use distinct names (e.g., calculate_damage_v2 with deprecation note)
